svg.title: Row-wise sparse input distribution
svg.desc: Input distribution: H2D staging, host reads, and each payload collective. Solid bars: logical execution/access scopes; hollow dashed bars: unconsumed requests. Blue H2D, red D2H/host sync, purple AllToAll, amber request wait, green stream dependency. _input_dists[row_wise](unique KJT) dispatch under KJT_SPLITS_DIST block_bucketize_sparse_features owner = id // block; local_id = id % block; equal contiguous shards in this example KJTAllToAll(bucketized KJT) activities [46-54] compute tensor splits dist_splits → length_per_key → _safe_tolist If uncached and nonempty CUDA lengths: sum → D2H → current_stream.synchronize() → Python list torch.tensor(splits, device=cuda) Stage per-peer lengths / values split lists; also stage stride metadata for fixed stride. construct split metadata activities [55-58] stack/stage per-peer counts; torch.stack(...).flatten() AllToAll #1: splits activity [59] ncclDevKernel_SendRecv First wait: consume the split-size request KJTAllToAllSplitsAwaitable delegates to SplitsAllToAllAwaitable.wait(). splits Work.wait() Establish readiness for the following metadata read; host readback is a separate step below. _safe_tolist_2d(received CUDA splits) D2H + current_stream.synchronize(): CPU needs receive sizes before allocating payload buffers. wait() -> allocate receive tensors Sample [60-61] D2H/H2D metadata is expanded above and below; allocate from known receive sizes. _get_recat: Python permutation → CUDA tensor Fixed/equal stride: torch.tensor(recat, device=cuda, dtype=int32); uneven batches use extra offset tensors. AllToAll #2: KJT lengths Example execution [62]; one all_to_all_single for the lengths tensor. AllToAll #3: KJT ID values Example execution [63]; a separate all_to_all_single for ID values; optional fields add calls. Second wait: consume payload Work handles Lengths and values must be usable before recat / local KJT reconstruction. KeyedJaggedTensor.dist_init(recat) activities [64-72] restore feature-major KJT dist_init(...).sync() → length_per_key Fixed-stride path, uncached nonempty CUDA lengths: D2H + stream synchronization to rebuild host metadata. received local-shard KJT input_dist outer wait().wait() completes
